# staticform_notification_preferences (Data Source)

The signed-in user's notification preferences and the full notification event catalog (read-only). Requires the `User.Notifications.GetPreferences` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "staticform_notification_preferences" "me" {}

output "notification_event_keys" {
  value = [for e in data.staticform_notification_preferences.me.events : e.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `digest_hour_local` (Number) Hour of the day (0 to 23, in `time_zone_id`) at which the daily digest is sent.
- `email_enabled` (Boolean) Master email switch.
- `email_mode` (String) `Immediate` or `DailyDigest`.
- `events` (Attributes List) Every notification event with the user's choice, ordered by category and key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `quiet_hours` (Attributes) Daily window in which immediate email is held. Null when there are no quiet hours. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quiet_hours))
- `time_zone_id` (String) Time zone used for the digest hour and quiet hours.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) `Account`, `System`, `Forms`, `Submissions`, `Billing`, `Integrations`, or `Attention`.
- `email` (Boolean) Whether the event is also emailed.
- `email_by_default` (Boolean) Whether the event is emailed unless the user chose otherwise.
- `in_app` (Boolean) Whether the event appears in the in-app inbox.
- `key` (String) Event key, for example `product.StorageWarning`.
- `opt_out_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the user may change this event's choices.
- `sample_title` (String) Example title of the notification.


<a id="nestedatt--quiet_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quiet_hours`

Read-Only:

- `end` (String) End of the window, formatted `HH:mm`.
- `start` (String) Start of the window, formatted `HH:mm`.
